Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: A reusable shift definition (klok-vorm template): a name, wall-clock startTime/endTime, a break duration and an optional org-unit scope. Shifts are authored once and reused across many RosterAssignments — the schema carries no dated instance data of its own. A shift whose endTime is not after its startTime denotes a night shift crossing midnight (the AttendanceRecord night-shift convention): an assignment referencing it composes a plannedEnd on the following calendar day (rostering MVP, design D1/D2).

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description: Wall-clock time (HH:MM) the shift ends. A value not after startTime denotes a dienst crossing midnight — RosterAssignment composes plannedEnd on the following calendar day for such a shift.

breakMinutes.title: Break minutes
breakMinutes.description: Unpaid break minutes built into this shift. Copied onto plannedBreakMinutes for every assignment referencing this shift (design D2).

orgUnitId.title: Org unit
orgUnitId.description: UUID reference to the OrgUnit this shift is scoped to; null when the shift is usable org-wide.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this shift definition is currently offered for new assignments.

Roster.title: Roster
Roster.description: The publishable header for one planning period + scope: the unit of publication for a set of RosterAssignments. Publishing (status concept -> gepubliceerd) freezes the plan and makes it the team's roster; intrekken returns it to concept for edits, with the change visible in the audit trail. A Roster carries no hours of its own — it groups its RosterAssignments (rostering MVP, design D1/D3).

publiceren.description: Freeze the plan and make it the team's roster. Its RosterAssignments join the standing occ humaniq:rules:audit ATW cross-check once published (design D4).

intrekken.description: Return a published roster to concept for correction (the AttendanceRecord heropenen precedent). The change stays visible in the audit trail.

period.title: Period
period.description: The planning period this roster covers: an ISO week (YYYY-Www) or an ISO month (YYYY-MM).

orgUnitId.title: Org unit
orgUnitId.description: UUID reference to the OrgUnit this roster is scoped to; null for an org-wide roster.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Optional administration/entity code this roster belongs to, matching the PayrollRun.administrationId vocabulary.

status.title: Status
status.description: Roster lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> gepubliceerd via publiceren, gepubliceerd -> concept via intrekken).

RosterAssignment.title: Roster assignment
RosterAssignment.description: One employee on one shift on one date within a Roster. Carries the projected planned-clock fields plannedStart/plannedEnd/plannedBreakMinutes, composed from the assignment's date and the referenced Shift's startTime/endTime/breakMinutes at write time (never a live Shift join — design D2), so the Arbeidstijdenwet cross-check (NlRosterChecks) is decidable from the assignment alone, exactly as AttendanceRecord's raw clockIn/clockOut/breakMinutes decide the realised-day checks. A published plan stays stable against a later Shift edit: the projected fields are re-derived only when the assignment itself is re-written. No approval status of its own — the plan's only lifecycle lives on the Roster header.

rosterId.title: Roster
rosterId.description: UUID reference to the Roster this assignment belongs to.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the assigned Employee.

shiftId.title: Shift
shiftId.description: UUID reference to the Shift this assignment projects onto its date.

date.title: Date
date.description: The working day this assignment covers (ISO 8601 date) — the working-day key even for a night shift whose plannedEnd falls after midnight, mirroring AttendanceRecord.date.

plannedStart.title: Planned start
plannedStart.description: Composed from date + the referenced Shift's startTime at write time. Read raw by the ATW checks, never re-derived from a live Shift join (design D2).

plannedEnd.title: Planned end
plannedEnd.description: Composed from date + the referenced Shift's endTime at write time, rolled to the following calendar day when the shift's endTime is not after its startTime (night shift). Null passes nl-atw-max-werkdag/nl-atw-pauze vacuously — shift length not decidable (the AttendanceRecord open-day precedent).

plannedBreakMinutes.title: Planned break minutes
plannedBreakMinutes.description: Copied from the referenced Shift's breakMinutes at write time. Input to the nl-atw-pauze check.

userId.title: User
userId.description: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the assigned employee (mijn-hr-self-service pattern) — a plain NC-user-id string, a copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, never a $ref relation, mirroring AttendanceRecord.userId / Timesheet.userId verbatim.
